text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I run into Little Cocon and Bitter Glasse at a sporting goods store.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I also encounter Happy Meek as she continues training late into the night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All three are making an effort to help out the trainers they trust so much before embarking on their third year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inspired by their example, I vow to work even harder with <chrname> as we head towards our goal!
